ABSOLUTE_PATHS.description: Boolean - show member paths as absolute

ACTIVATION_PROG_RE.description: Regular expression describing programs which trigger an audit

AGGREGATED_SUBCMD.description: Boolean - disable build avoidance within aggregated subcommands

AGGREGATION_LINE_BREAK_RE.description: Break-aggregation RE based on cmd line

AGGREGATION_LINE_STRONG_RE.description: Strong-aggregation RE based on cmd line

AGGREGATION_LINE_WEAK_RE.description: Weak-aggregation RE based on cmd line

AGGREGATION_PROG_BREAK_RE.description: Break-aggregation RE based on prog name

AGGREGATION_PROG_STRONG_RE.description: Strong-aggregation RE based on prog name

AGGREGATION_PROG_WEAK_RE.description: Weak-aggregation RE based on prog name

AGGREGATION_STYLE.description: Whether to aggregate all, some, or none

AUDIT_IGNORE_PATH_RE.description: Regular expression matching pathnames to be completely ignored

AUDIT_IGNORE_PROG_RE.description: Regular expression matching programs to be completely ignored

AUDIT_ONLY.description: Boolean - audit file and command activity but do no uploads or downloads

BASE_DIR.description: The root of this project tree

CSV.description: Boolean - transitional flag to use the older CSV format instead of JSON

DCODE_ALL.description: Boolean - derive data-code for all involved files

DCODE_CACHE_SECS.description: Timestamp offset from start time for dcode cache

DEPTH.description: Special modifiable EV carrying the cmd depth

DOWNLOAD_ONLY.description: Boolean - allow downloads but no uploads

EXECUTE_ONLY.description: Boolean - suppress auditing and just run the command

LEAVE_ROADMAP.description: Boolean - don't unlink roadmap file when done

LOG_TIME_STAMP.description: Boolean - prepend a timestamp to each line of logfile

MAKE_DEPENDS.description: Dump makefile dependency info to files with this extension

MAKE_FILE.description: Generate a Makefile in the named file

MAKE_ONESHELL.description: Boolean - ask make to use a single shell for each recipe

MEMBERS_ONLY.description: Boolean - show and consider only project member files

MMAP_LARGER_THAN.description: Use memory mapping to read files larger than this size

MONITOR_HOST.description: Host on which monitor is running for audit delivery connections

MONITOR_LISTENERS.description: Number of ports on which to listen for audit deliveries

MONITOR_PORT.description: Port(s) on which monitor listens for audit delivery connections

MONITOR_TIMEOUT_SECS.description: How often to check health of audited process, in seconds

NO_MONITOR.description: Boolean - dump truly raw audit data without aggregation

ORIGINAL_DATESTAMP.description: Boolean - set mod time of downloaded files back to uploaded time

OUTPUT_FILE.description: Dump output data to specified file

PCCODE.description: Special modifiable EV holding the parent cmd code
PCCODE.comment: Buffer big enough for SHA-1 hash plus metadata.

PCMDID.description: Special modifiable EV holding the parent pid

PERL_CMD.description: Name of or path to the preferred Perl binary

PRINT_ELAPSED.description: Print elapsed wall-clock time at exit if > 0

REUSE_ROADMAP.description: Boolean - use the pre-existing roadmap (debugging use only)

ROADMAPFILE.description: Path to the file containing the CA/PS/PTX database

SESSIONID.description: The HTTP session id cookie value received from the server

SESSION_TIMEOUT_SECS.description: The HTTP session timeout used during a build, in seconds

SHOP_IGNORE_PATH_RE.description: Regular expression matching pathnames to ignore when shopping

SHOP_TIME_PRECISION.description: Number of decimal digits to consider in timestamp comparisons
SHOP_TIME_PRECISION.comment: This is here because of a historical Unix flaw: though some systems *track* file times to the granularity of nanoseconds, the only POSIX/SUS way of *setting* a timestamp is utimes() which can handle only microseconds. Thus, comparing nanoseconds is unfair because a command like "touch" cannot control them.

STRICT.description: Boolean - a shorthand for all strict options

STRICT_AUDIT.description: Boolean - abort if any command cannot be audited

STRICT_DOWNLOAD.description: Boolean - abort if any audited objects cannot be downloaded

STRICT_ERROR.description: Boolean - abort after any error message

STRICT_UPLOAD.description: Boolean - abort if any audited objects cannot be uploaded

SYNCHRONOUS_TRANSFERS.description: Upload files in the foreground, for debugging

TRACK_ENV_RE.description: Regular expression matching environment variables to show in audit

UPLOAD_ONLY.description: Boolean - disable downloads and build avoidance

UPLOAD_READS.description: Boolean - upload files read as well as written
